notes.title: Isle of the Eagle Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hi Steam Gamers! Isle of the Eagle just launched a Major update for Version 1.2. Some of the new features are:

1) Smoother framerates (especially for vantage point cutscenes). *Also, users can now manually adjust their ideal graphics settings in the options menu to customize to their liking or make the game work the best according to their PC specs (this is nice for users who may have an older PC).  

2) Shorter and smoother cutscenes when delivering treasures + fixed an issue where some treasures were delivered from the wrong side of the map. Now all cutscenes look good and make sense. 

3) Ability to now land on top of the Hot Air Balloon 

4) Added new background music to the snowy mountain region 

5) Caribou and Foxes are now friendly (Only Bears attack - Polar Bears and Grizzly Bears)

6) Added new yellow light + Sound effects/visual effects to the Treasure Chest 

7) The Treasure Chest in the Ice Cave can now be opened by walking up to it and "inspecting" it to view your treasure collection from in the game 

8) Fixed a glitch with humpback whale where the humpback whale would skip from area to area. Now that is smoothed out and there's no glitch. 

9) Fixed a Glitch with Eagle Glow Level 2 ability. Now it works just as well as Eagle Glow Level 1 ability, but it's faster. 

10) Added a brand new "Eagle Sense" ability. Now, when the Bald Eagle gets close to treasure, he will hear a "chime" sound effect that gets louder and louder until he inspects the treasure + he will see a Treasure Chest icon that indicates where the treasure is. 

11) Fixed Drone Camera so that now it appears right next to the Bald Eagle (wherever he is) whenever you want to take it out. 

12) Removed the Energy bar below the Hunting medals so that now the Bald Eagle never gets tired and can interact with a fireplace to sleep whenever he wants and fly around the map indefinitely. 

We hope you enjoy these updates! We know that we did! In many ways, the game looks and feels much better now :)
